name: AmiBlitz 3
description: BASIC compiler IDE (successor of Blitz Basic 2)
notes: wbstart.library is not bundled (optional: Workbench-start of compiled programs)

System/HelpIndex.txt, HelpIndexCache.bin, TokenList.hashmap and token_mapping_userlibs.txt were generated by AmiBlitz3 itself on the AmigaOS 3.1 reference (its first start indexes Docs/ for ~20 emulated minutes) and copied into the app directory (Phase 238)
The IDE needs the -PED argument when started from a CLI; it writes into its own directory (scenarios use writable: true)
